## Context / Problem
Each gate answers "enabled? / what ref? / fail mode on error?" separately: plan-review claim and close and the completion verifier share `gates.gate_enabled` (`src/rebar/_commands/gates.py:96`, tri-state, warns) but code review has its own two-state `code_review_enabled` (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:277`, silent `except Exception`); the ref is resolved through `gate_source.resolve_gate_handle` (`src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py:75`) except the completion gate, which bypasses it at `src/rebar/_commands/close_autoresume.py:141`; error posture differs (claim exit 1; plan-review-close `unavailable` dict at `gates.py:286`; completion exit 11/1 via `failure.outcome_of` at `close_precheck.py:656-686`; code review INDETERMINATE dict). In CI, "this change predates the gate script" is a shell guard copy-pasted twelve times (`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:146,160,184,198,212,289,378,571`, `_optionality.yml` ×3, `_mutation.yml:64`); bug `sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly` added the twelfth and `anxious-resistant-urson` was a missing one. Epic RP-06 (`uneducated-habitual-primate`) owns criteria *discovery* and does not cover this; task `spongy-rich-lizard` covers the MCP config resolvers only; epic `sluggish-moistful-chital` (idea) is the fail-closed design question and is not changed here — every gate keeps its documented fail posture.

## Approach
Add `src/rebar/_commands/gate_policy.py` with `resolve(gate, *, repo_root, ref=None) -> GateDecision(enabled: GateState, ref, sha, fail_mode)` where `fail_mode` is declared per gate (`OPEN_WARN`, `CLOSED_EXIT1`, `CLOSED_EXIT11_IF_RETRYABLE`, `INDETERMINATE`) and all four callers consume it; route `code_review_enabled` through `gate_enabled`; route the completion gate's ref through `resolve_gate_handle`. Add `.github/actions/skip-if-predates-gate/action.yml` and replace the twelve guards. Guard: `if [[ ! -f scripts/` appears in no workflow file; `except Exception` around a `verify.*` config read appears only in `gate_policy.py`.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_commands/gate_policy.py` (new), `src/rebar/_commands/gates.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/close_autoresume.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py`, `.github/actions/skip-if-predates-gate/action.yml` (new), `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`, `.github/workflows/_optionality.yml`, `.github/workflows/_mutation.yml`, `tests/unit/commands/test_gate_policy.py` (new), `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`.

## Testing
Table test: for each gate × {enabled, disabled, unreadable config, resolver exception} the decision and the exit/verdict equal today's. Edge: unreadable config still warns and fails open for the three gates documented to do so. Pinning: `tests/unit/test_gate_state_tristate_f5c4.py`, `tests/unit/test_close_gate_unreadable_config_2091.py`, `tests/unit/test_close_precheck*.py`, the workflow-body tests from `sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every gate's observable behaviour for the four conditions is unchanged; checked by the table test and pinning suites.
- [ ] `grep -rn "if \[\[ ! -f scripts/" .github/workflows` is empty and the composite action is used at twelve sites; checked by the grep and `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`.
- [ ] The completion gate resolves its ref through `resolve_gate_handle`; checked by a test that `REBAR_GATE_REF` is honoured by `close --ref`-less closes exactly as by `review-plan`.
